svg.title: Five-rater configurations and P4 predictive variability

cc:Work.dc:title: Five-rater configurations and P4 predictive variability
cc:Work.dc:description: Fig. S2. Rater configurations and predictive variability in one five-rater validation case, selected nearest the median localization error among 14 eligible images before visual review. (A) Five complete rater configurations and their reference from coordinates averaged across raters. (B) The same reference and the mean of 50 stochastic predictions. The reference is not anatomical truth; segments join angle-defining landmarks. (C–E) P4 offsets about the MC mean (+): mean conditional covariance with component centers aligned, covariance of the 50 component means (denominator 50), and their sum with 1,024 illustration-only mixture draws. All ellipses have Mahalanobis radius one, not confidence-interval coverage. A/B share coordinate bounds; C–E share offset bounds; all axes have equal pixel scales. These P4 marginals do not validate the full joint distribution.
